subject: Front-end audit accepted; resume /rpc after this handoff
body: Your front-end audit is accepted and reconciled in design/11 section 7. I implemented the one structural change you identified: board.conversationRows is now the single chronological source for Overview and Chat; quote() uses a scoped ref; the browser test injects a deterministic tall fixture; unit and e2e suites pass. T-0150/T-0151/T-0152 are done. Resume T-0122 after this handoff, with the same D17 constraint.
